profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kroger Technology and Digital
profile.summary:
I've always had an interest in technology, but it wasn't until I tried my hand at programming that I realized just how fascinating I found its creative thinking and problem-solving aspects. My inquisitive nature led me to take online courses on Python and web development, and the more I learned, the more I knew it was something I wanted to pursue. This led me to attend the 14-week Tech Elevator bootcamp, where I completed the full-stack web development course, which enabled me to join the Kroger Design System team as a web developer.

I spent the majority of my career in editing and publishing as a content developer, project manager and team lead on a variety of art-focused print, digital, and video products. This path allowed me to combine my degrees in English editing and computer animation, and provided me with specialist knowledge of creating illustrated instructional texts, and topical knowledge of fine arts, comics, animation, character design, and crafts, as well as furthering my proficiency with Adobe InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator.

My experience in the publishing industry allowed me to exercise my ability to work with diverse personalities as I guided authors and interacted with publishing peers. Being naturally empathetic allowed me to better understand and communicate with clients and team members, which enhanced the quality of our work and ensured the completion of projects. As a managing content developer, I worked hard to clear obstacles for my team and to ensure each member's ability to get the job done as efficiently as possible.

On the job, I've always been the one to jump at the opportunity to take on new skills and projects, and to step in when team members need help. I'm an adaptable learner, which makes me flexible when industry trends and project needs change unexpectedly. I don't consider success to mean success for myself alone, but also for my co-workers, clients, and company. Helping, mentoring, and elevating each other will push us toward our goals faster and enrich our work with meaning and enjoyment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Kroger Design System (KDS)
- Manages KDS documentation sites, including design and content updates, certificate and vulnerability oversight, workflow and deployment upkeep, testing updates, and migrations.
- Supports Web-focused design system team by performing component audits and updates and maintaining npm and Snyk vulnerabilities.
- Lead effort to add Playwright testing to design system documentation site.
- Collaborated on documentation site redesign and rebuild to move from Gatsby to Next.js.
- Prepared report on Divio documentation system for management to determine it's viability for KDS use.
- Oversaw color system migration of design system documentation site.

Community Design System Alliance (CDSA)
- Collaborated with team to review banner site for design system inconsistencies and correct them site-wide.

Certified LUMA practitioner

positions.title: C#/.NET Full-Stack Development Graduate
positions.description:
Asset Panda CMS
- Developed components of content management system using Javascript and Vue.js.

Cake Bakery Ordering Application
- Developed a web app using Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, C#/.NET and MS SQL

National Park Weather Application
- Developed a web app using ASP.NET MVC and Dark Sky API.

National Park Registration Application
- Developed a console registration app using C#/.NET and MS SQL Server Express.

Vending Machine Application
- Developed a vending machine console application with C#/.NET, OOP principles, and file.io.

- Manga Academy by Chihiro Howe
- Dragon Draw by Piper Thibodeau
- How to Draw Without Talent by Danny Gregory

positions.title: Managing Content Developer, Fine Art Books
positions.description:
- Promoted after being approached to fulfill upcoming managerial role.
- Oversaw 2 book lines and in-house editorial team to ensure completion of publishing schedule for all projects.
- Expedited editorial materials for Costco and Target projects to reach 100% completion by requested dates.
- Developed manuscripts for key bestselling authors to enhance goodwill and retain author relationships.
- Created company-wide author newsletter to improve communication regarding business updates.
- Coordinated with overseas publishing groups to jointly produce book editions for the North American market.

positions.title: Content Developer, Fine Art Books
positions.description:
- Promoted after selection by fine arts team to fulfill available role over other candidates.
- Supervised 2 annual Market Book projects, including team hiring and content proposals per industry changes.
- Tested new content management system to determine usability and assess needs for additional functionality.

positions.title: Content Editor, Craft Books
positions.description:
- Promoted after demonstrating excellence in an Associate role.
- Authored technical and introductory book sections to complete projects and prevent production delays.
- Reorganized Craftables initiative to create 2–4 craft patterns per month for sale in online shops.
- Acquired 2–5 new book titles per year based on industry trends and revenue forecasting.

positions.title: Associate Editor, Craft Books
positions.description: - Evaluated and resolved book errata questions for customers and increased resolution rate by 80%.
